description: Replace the documents of several visuals at once, keyed by each visual's ref. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

additionalProperties.description: The visual's whole JSON document, valid for the visual's type: the rules per type are on create_visual's document and in describe_visual_types; get_visual shows the current one.

data.description: The new documents, keyed by the ref of the visual each one replaces, so one call keeps a whole dashboard fresh. Each is read as PUT /v1/visuals/{id}/data reads it (whole document, numeric strings coerced). Every entry is tried in the order sent: 200 when all were written, 422 batch_failed with the same results when any was not.

name: batch_update
title: Batch update
